info.title: Lotmark
info.description:
ISO 17034 reference material producer platform.

Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. The `code` field is the machine-readable one; `title` is that code humanised for display and must not be branched on. Where a refusal was recorded, `auditSeq` points at the ledger entry.

This document is generated from a registry that a test compares against the routes the server actually registered, in both directions. It cannot describe an endpoint that does not exist, and an endpoint cannot exist without appearing here.

tags.description: Scheduled job health and disaster-recovery drills.

sessionCookie.name: lotmark_session
sessionCookie.description: An opaque server-side session. Cookies rather than a bearer token because this domain needs IMMEDIATE revocation — a locked account, an idle timeout, a withdrawn competence — and a stateless token cannot be withdrawn before it expires.

title.description: For display. Do not branch on it.
